job.job_description:
TCS F2F Drive | GenAI Engineer

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is hiring talented professionals passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and NLP.




Role: GenAI Engineer
Location: Bangalore
Experience: 5 - 12 Years
Interview Date: 29-Aug-2026 (Saturday)
Interview Time: 9:30 AM - 1:00 PM
Mode: Face-to-Face Interview




Required Skills

Generative AI (GenAI)
Python Programming
Machine Learning & Deep Learning
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
LangChain / LangGraph
LlamaIndex
SQL (Hive / PySpark DataFrames)
OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic APIs
Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone)

Technical Expertise

Core Python Fundamentals (OOPs, Functions, Modules, Decorators, Exception Handling, Data Structures & Algorithms)
NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM
PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLflow
spaCy, NLTK, Transformers, Sentence Transformers
OCR Technologies (Pytesseract, EasyOCR)
GitHub & CI/CD Pipelines
Cloud & Big Data Technologies (Preferred)

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise-scale applications.
Build and optimize machine learning pipelines and NLP-based applications.
Develop Agentic AI solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures using vector databases such as FAISS and Pinecone.
Integrate AI/ML models into real-time and batch-processing applications.
Build scalable APIs and AI services leveraging OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic models.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative AI-driven solutions.
Create and maintain comprehensive technical and model documentation.
Follow best practices in AI/ML governance, CI/CD, and software engineering.
